prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for winning home wait_info tests where predictions were too low.
Adding a new screen at the finish stage (2 tests) or adoption stage (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and had to be stopped early.
Reordering sign-in steps (2 tests) and adding sign-in hints (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (7 tests) were helpful in three significant wins, though four tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence for most other specific kinds of change remains thin because few categories have at least two agreeing tests.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Background Desktop Readiness Notification: Add desktop system notifications and estimated completion timers to the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the app during generation. (why: Mean home wait time is over 38 minutes (2336s); users need assurance that generation continues seamlessly in the background.)
1: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Visibility & Tray Hint: Add an explicit hint and callout component on the finish screen explaining how to locate and show the pet if it spawns behind desktop windows. (why: Support mails report pets not showing on desktop (3 emails) and confusion on controlling or hiding the pet (3 emails).)
2: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance: Update headline and body on the photo upload screen to emphasize clear lighting and single-subject framing. (why: Support emails cite custom pet generation failures and unexpected visual results (3 emails).)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Assembly Progress Timer: Display active progress percentage and an estimated countdown timer on the waiting screen with periodic tip rotations every 15 seconds. (why: Home waiting step has a 201s median / 2336s mean, and structured wait info has proven effective in past wins.)
